title: Count each of the six model-call hooks' fires over one week, then delete each that never fired
why: Owner's answer b on page item 248 (Nov 6, 12:19 CST): measure how often each hook fires for a week, then delete the ones that never fire. What was built followed a misrouted note (option a): docs/plans/builtin-hook-survey.md (86da64a52) has an unmeasured "Cost now" column and no fire count.
note: Read the counts on demand from logs that already exist (guard.log), with no new logging. guard.log lives on the owner's machines, so this needs a session on his computer. The six hooks: call_judge, prose_judge, reply_judge, feedback_guard, report_guard, sendmessage_state. Ruling (owner chat 11:26 CST Nov 10, relayed by the coordinator 11:31 CST): "sessions like triage are not being archived right? so it can be doing work via agents in its session/lane -- i just said no new spawns at this time". The freeze bars new sessions only; triage builds this step with agents in its own session (page item 492 closed). This note is the ruling's home until a decision holds it.
